name: Who Are Those Guys
description: Veteran North Fork band based in Mattituck that plays its own rock, blues, folk and country songs plus classic covers, with a sound often compared to Neil Young, The Band and Creedence. It plays about 100 shows a year at East End breweries, wineries, lodges and festivals and has won Dan's Papers 'Best of the Best' many times.

dancing.notes: Mostly brewery, winery and fundraiser shows on the North Fork, often in the afternoon, with a mix of originals and classic covers. Some people may dance at lodge nights and festivals, but we found no report of dancing at its shows.
